children: According to ChainCatcher, Bitcoin layer-2 network Stacks has opened a governance vote on its 4.1 upgrade, which includes changes related to Clarity 7 and BTC deposits. The proposal requires at least 80% approval in both the staked STX and liquid STX tallies, with at least 80 million staked STX participating.

title: Stacks Launches Vote on 4.1 Upgrade Covering Clarity 7 and BTC Deposit Changes
